problems.title: Longest Palindromic Substring
problems.gist: You get a string s. Return the longest contiguous piece of s that reads the same forwards and backwards (a palindromic substring). If several pieces share the maximum length, returning any one of them is accepted.

problems.title: Longest Common Prefix
problems.gist: Given an array of strings strs, return the longest string that is a prefix of every string in the array. If they share no prefix, return the empty string "".

problems.title: Reverse Words in a String
problems.gist: You are given a string s holding a line of text. A word is a maximal run of non-space characters. Words are separated by at least one space, and the line may also start or end with spaces.

problems.title: Find the Index of the First Occurrence in a String
problems.gist: You get two strings, haystack and needle. Return the smallest index i such that haystack contains needle starting at position i, or -1 if needle never appears in haystack.

problems.title: Encode and Decode Strings
problems.gist: Design a codec that turns a list of strings into one string, which is sent over a network and turned back into the original list on the other side.

problems.title: Text Justification
problems.gist: You get an array of strings words (tokens of a caption) and a line width maxWidth. Lay the words out as text in which every line has exactly maxWidth characters and is fully (left and right) justified, and return the lines as a list of strings.
